notes.title: Demo Update #4: NPC Speed Fix & More
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]With this patch we have addressed the last significant issues players have found in the demo. This includes fixes to NPCs tied to framerate, which at higher fps, significantly slowed them down.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch notes - September 20th[/p][list][*][p]Fixed arms getting stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Invisible player when rejoining[/p][/*][*][p]NPC speed is framerate independent now[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Steam overlay behavior when joining friends[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please note this is certainly the last patch we issue for the demo. Now it is time to fully concentrate on the Early Access release of the game. We'll have an update on that very soon.[/p][p][/p][p]See you around and goop responsibly![/p]

notes.title: 100,000 Demo Players! Thank you!
notes.notes: [p]Greetings my wonderful mouth breathers,[/p][p][/p][p]We've been a bit busy patching the demo here and there, but I'm happy to announce that over 100,000 people have played the demo. That is absolutely nuts! Also, we just hit 250,000 wishlists (wow!).[/p][p][/p][h2][u]100,000 [strike]aliens[/strike] store owners[/u][/h2][p][/p][p]114,000 people have downloaded and played the demo to be exact. Some other fun facts you might be interested in: [/p][list][*][p]Over 55% of demo players played for more than 1 hour [/p][/*][*][p]Over 25% of demo players played for more than 2 hours [/p][/*][*][p]2% of players have played for 5 hours or more[/p][/*][/list][p]The top 5 countries that have played the demo are: [/p][olist][*][p]United States[/p][/*][*][p]Germany[/p][/*][*][p]Poland[/p][/*][*][p]Turkey[/p][/*][*][p]France[/p][/*][/olist][p]And countries from 6 to 10, in order, are: United Kingdom, Brazil, Canada, Saudi Arabia, Japan. That's quite a worldly mix of places, thank you very much for playing and checking out the game![/p][p][/p][h2][u]What is next?[/u] [/h2][p][/p][p]Players have been really helpful in figuring out bugs, general quality of life upgrades, and other tweaks to make the game better. Right now the demo is in a good place and it shows what Roadside Research is about. [b]This means that the demo will not get any further updates for the time being.[/b] [/p][p]The Early Access launch of Roadside Research is coming very soon! So we are fully focused on that right now. It's time to cook... More on that in the future, don't you worry.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Cursed Images from the Discord[/u][/h2][p][/p][p]Courtesy of Yaackz, MattBTW, and HaywoodJahblomei (from top to bottom) who have spent their precious hours to create these beautiful images for all of us to witness.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for playing Roadside Research, and talk soon. Bye bye![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643699/289e2a0dc7241dee49a820025388cd0d8162e81f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643699/af1bc1032f4a3cbe05ef0a7a66c2e923de027cca.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643699/c6f420c6f3c58bd57078e0d1ee556af1325fa077.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #3:
notes.notes: [p]Check out Patch #2[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3643170/view/514095596535022696"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Check out Patch #1[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3643170/view/514095596535021637"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Hello everyone, new day, new patch![/p][p][/p][p]As always thank you so much playing and taking the time to conduct essential research on humanity. We read every single review and Steam forum to make sure that we are making the game in line with your feedback and expectations. [/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like to have longer chats don't hesitate to hang out with us in [url="https://discord.gg/XGef9H8Rk4"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Important Disclaimer[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Customers walk and act slow at higher framerates[/b]. We are working on a fix, but until then make sure to cap the framerate at 60fps[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Patch Notes - Friday, September 19th[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some people were unable to invite their friends (You need to select the friends tab in the steam overlay)[/p][/*][*][p]You can now click the money on the counter to take money back[/p][/*][*][p]There are outlines on the camera and trash bag dispenser after unlocking them to make it more clear[/p][/*][*][p]Door colliders adjusted so items wont get stuck as much[/p][/*][*][p]Added some decorations for you to place![/p][/*][*][p]Unstretched the pump notification for too high price[/p][/*][*][p]NPC throw their trash in a trashcan instead of the ground more frequently[/p][/*][*][p]The "Camera, Lights, Alien!"  objective shows the correct research values now[/p][/*][*][p]The arms of the alien swing around less and is lower to decrease motion sickness[/p][/*][*][p]Added VFX when dying to show the cost of it[/p][/*][*][p]Contest winner masks added[/p][/*][*][p]iGPUs are autodetected now[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing and keep on gooping![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #2: Small Patch
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We're continuing the roll-out of small fixes with tweaks to current values and gameplay to match player feedback. So thank you for playing and taking the time to write your thoughts about your experience in Roadside Research, it's much appreciated! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Important Disclaimers[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Because of this patch, progress may be lost. If you want to make sure backup your save files here before updating: C:\\Users<username>\\AppData\\LocalLow\\CyberneticWalrus\\Roadside Research\\saves[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customers walk and act slow at higher framerates[/b]. We are working on a fix, but until then make sure to cap the framerate at 60fps[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2][b]Patch Notes - Thursday September 18th:[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]New & Improved[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Added support for Ultra-Wide resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Option to run on devices with integrated GPUs (You can find it in the graphics settings)[/p][/*][*][p]Exterior lighting [/p][/*][*][p]Customers more tolerant of high prices (finally, capitalism works),[/p][/*][*][p]Orange juice is now officially a drink[/p][/*][*][p]Fuel price visual feedback added (shelf items still guesswork)[/p][/*][*][p]Joined players can now see fuel prices[/p][/*][*][p]Added crosshair when holding tools/items[/p][/*][*][p]Longer display for requested fuel type speech bubble[/p][/*][/list][p]  [b]Fixes & Tweaks[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Prevented multiple saves stacking in one slot. (Read below!)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed fridge contents not saving[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed duplicate box saves[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player lock-on-spawn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player hands stuck after box destruction[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed trash bag blocking walking when looking down[/p][/*][*][p]Holding fuel barrels/trash bags less jittery[/p][/*][*][p]Door collider updated to stop eating boxes[/p][/*][*][p]Government agent + gas pump dirt SFX fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial title background no longer lingers[/p][/*][*][p]Customers no longer despawn when leaving is interrupted[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed max customers blocking gas pump spawns[/p][/*][*][p]Customers react to all dirt stains now[/p][/*][*][p]Updated NPC “making mess” animations[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs detect alien activity faster [/p][/*][*][p]Steam overlay now handles wishlist/join/invite[/p][/*][*][p]Added Russian language support [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various localization spelling errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fuel stock now formatted in shopping screen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Important Disclaimer[/b][/p][p]Because of this patch, progress may be lost. Currently over 6,000 people are there and the Alien fun is just starting.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update: Feedback, New Fixes, and What is Next
notes.notes: [h2]New patch notes have been posted![/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3643170/announcements/detail/514095596535022697?snr=2___"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]The demo launch was quite crazy. More than 30,000 people played in the first two days which was much more than we expected. So thank you for taking the time to play Roadside Research![/p][p]With all these players also came a lot of feedback, thoughts, and opinions. Very useful stuff for us to understand what the expectations are for the game, and more importantly what we can do about it.[/p][p][/p][p]So we have launched a new patch just now including the following fixes. There will also be another patch later this week with further tweaks/changes, more on that below. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Wednesday September 17th Changelog (today):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sped up customer movement[/p][list][*][p]This is a temporary fix. More information on NPC walk-speed below [b](1)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Locking your FPS to 60 will make NPCs move at their normal speed[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Economy is now more profitable so players have more agency in the first days[/p][list][*][p]Cheaper shelves[/p][/*][*][p]Higher profit margins for base items[/p][/*][*][p]Higher profit margins on all items[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Head is now a separate mesh, set to shadow only[/p][/*][*][p]Cash register lowers suspicion by very very little[/p][/*][*][p]Automatic trashcan automatically scans when one piece of trash is added, instantly give points[/p][/*][*][p]Dying and respawning now costs research points, store reputation also gets "damaged". This is to make getting caught more impactful[/p][/*][/list][p]This is what we were able to implement over the course of the past 24 hours. Below are notes on what we plan on adding later, at the end of this week. We will try to implement everything but some of the points below might be delayed if they encounter unforeseen roadblocks.[/p][p][b](1)[/b] Regarding NPC speed, it turns out that they are frame-rate dependent. The more frames you have, the slower they go. Of course this is not intended and we are working on a fix for this asap.[/p][p][/p][p][b]End of Week Patch Plans[/b][/p][p]We will fix the most reported and prominent bugs such as, customers no spawning for the pump, boxes getting stuck in doorways, NPCs being too slow and many more![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for playing and we hope you enjoy your time gooping around! [/p]

notes.title: The Roadside Research Demo is available NOW!
notes.notes: [p][b]INCOMING TRANSMISSION FROM RESEARCH HQ[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, what an exciting day! The Roadside Research demo is available now for you to play. If you’ve been waiting to try the game before the early access release, now’s the perfect time to jump in, sweep the floors, and maybe scan a few humans for “research.”[/p][p][/p][p]Your mission on Earth is simple. Stay undercover while you conduct research on humans. As the first toes on the ground this doesn't come without risk. Make sure to keep the store tidy and keep the customers happy.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Roadside Research Demo is Available Now[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3911640/Roadside_Research_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Watch the New Trailer on YouTube[/h2][previewyoutube="rXXycgkw1JY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Features[/b] [/p][list][*][p]1-4 player co-op [/p][/*][*][p]Shop management and gas station management [/p][/*][*][p]State of the Art Alien Research Technology like trash cans and toilet cameras[/p][/*][*][p]Avoid government agents who are hunting for aliens[/p][/*][*][p]Choose how many toes you have on each foot [/p][/*][*][p]Funny physics and ragdoll systems[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Many beta testers from the discord have helped made this demo as fun as possible, a big thank you to all of them! We truly hope you enjoy your time gooping around. notes.title: Roadside Research will launch in Early Access this year! Beta test coming soon
notes.notes: [p]Greetings my fellow four-limbed friends,[/p][p][/p][h3]Playtesting Starting Soon[/h3][p]We are pleased to announce that the closed playtest for Roadside Research will commence in the following weeks. We are eager to welcome you to the store, as much time has been spent on the perfect layout for your perusal. Customers love looking at shelves! [/p][p][/p][h3]Demo after Playtesting[/h3][p]After the playtest, we will be launching a public demo for everyone to try. The demo will include: [/p][list][*][p]A complete gas station with a main shopping area and lavatories, with a fueling station outside.[/p][/*][*][p]Items for you to stock items in, shelves, fridges, and other rectangular things.[/p][/*][*][p]Research items like cameras and trash cans. Perfectly normal things for our good customers.[/p][/*][*][p]Customer satisfaction is our priority. (No suit people please!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Early Access![/h3][p]In other news, we wanted to let you know that the game will be launching in Early Access this year. We plan on updating the game regularly with free bigger system-wide overhauls in between.[/p][p]Why Early Access? Because we want YOU to help guide our research. We’ve already added community requests like the “How Many Toes Should an Alien Have” setting… who knows what you’ll suggest next?[/p][p][/p][h3]Join the Discord[/h3][p]We are currently running a community event where members can draw their very own masks ahead of launch. Some can even be put in game after! [url="https://discord.gg/XGef9H8Rk4"]Click here to join the Discord[/url].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643699/9058fce1ae91ed549ca9f3f821498933565fb612.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 150.000 Wishlists and Beta coming soon!
notes.notes: [h3][b]....----####::: TRANSMISSION INCOMING ###&&&////////[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Greetings again fellow shoppers and valued customers[/p][p][/p][p]Jeff and Jeff are pleased to announce that not 100.000, but 150.000 people have decided to add Roadside Research to their wishlists. Thanks again for supporting our [strike]invasio.[/strike].. store![/p][p][/p][p]The first phase of testing has begun. Right now, we’re deep into the [b]shop loop[/b], where players manage a gas station. Closed alpha testing with a very limited amount of test subjects has started.[/p][p][/p][p]The next phase of development involves [b]research[/b]. Not the kind you find in books. Think strange gadgets, human DNA analysis, and learning how to blend in without being noticed. This is where the alien side of the experience comes to life.[/p][p][/p][p]We plan to start general beta testing[b] this summer[/b] and we will do our best to include everyone who shared their email with us. You may be contacted for further observation.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to involve you even before our store officially opens. Which means that sign ups to the upcoming beta test are now open. You can sign up via [url="https://discord.gg/XGef9H8Rk4"]Discord on the page[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643699/bad8501f1b0eb4c3c5e7a90e2ce215076bc5481e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Until then, keep your disguise intact and never leave alien slime unattended.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your interest, we hope to see you soon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643699/27054890f6049c2b0e3d1a6f3b23917e0c5cd559.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]....----####::: TRANSMISSION END ###&&&////////[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643699/e7fb17b88b590fd82eede02b57a44cb237edcd13.png"][/img][/p]
